name: Charlie Walter
summary: I have 15 years’ professional experience in front-end software engineering and UI/UX design. I thrive on the design and craft of building great software, creating intuitive, accessible, and beautiful interfaces that work seamlessly for all users. I am hardworking, highly adaptable, and love working at the intersection of modern web technologies, inclusive user experience, and clean code. I thoughtfully integrate AI tooling into my day-to-day workflow to boost efficiency, backed by strong engineering discipline and UI design intuition. Having led engineering teams in the past, I am seeking my next hands-on role as a Senior Front-End / UI-UX Developer where I can focus on crafting exceptional user experiences and maintainable software.

career.description: Led UI/UX design initiatives for key Videris workflows, focusing heavily on user research, interface prototyping, and design consistency. Conducted comprehensive accessibility and colour contrast audits using Figma and Lighthouse against WCAG 2.1 standards to build inclusive, user-friendly interfaces.
